title: KitchenAid Fully Automatic Espresso Machine KF8, KES8558, Stainless Steel | 40+ Recipe Options, Built-In Grinder, Smart Dosing, 2.2L tank, Auto Milk Frothing, Removable Bean Hopper, LCD touch screen
features: Create personalized drinks with a touch of a button and choose from 40 plus recipe options like Espresso, Americano, Latte, Cappuccino and more
Removable bean hopper allows you to simply twist and lift to easily remove the bean hopper to empty, exchange or refill with fresh beans to suit your taste
The "Clean Me" indicator light alerts you when the espresso machine requires a cleaning cycle, and the cleaning cycle is programmable for varying water-hardness levels

From whole milk to plant-based, simply fill up the included milk container with your favorite milk and automatically create personalized milk drinks with the dual-drink delivery system - automatic milk frothing and heating feature gives you the exact amount of milk needed with the push of a button
Durable and built-to-last metal-clad construction offers beauty, precision and years of quality and reliability
Automatic Smart Dosing Technology - Get the right grind without the guesswork. The built-in grinder eases preparation by producing the ideal volume and consistency for every drink selection.

Model KES8558 includes (1) Fully Automatic Espresso Machine, (1) 2.2 L Water Tank, (1) Water Filter, (1) Bean Hopper (Removable), (1) Milk Container, (1) Milk Tube, (2) Cleaning Tablets (Brew Unit), (1) Spoon (Filter Mounting Aid), (1) Water Hardness Test Strip
